task.title: Step 02b [HARD GATE]: CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR validates the fix design
task.description: Validate the fix design at src/design/iss-0706-gbl116-bench-pre-flight.md against the WF-02 Step 1b gate criteria. Verify: (1) design covers all 20 acceptance criteria from the diagnosis; (2) design has no implementation code (interface signatures and data-flow are fine; actual code is not); (3) BACKEND-DEV and FRONTEND-DEV can implement without ambiguity; (4) lint check passes on the design file; (5) anti-dependencies are explicit. Return PASS or FAIL with detailed reasoning. If FAIL, list each blocker as a MINOR/MAJOR/BLOCKER issue.

context.approach: (a) + (d) — inject BPM_DB_URL into the bench step's migrate child process + fail loudly inside migrate.zig when provisionTenantSchema leaves migrations_applied_at NULL

validation_checklist: Design covers all 20 acceptance criteria from the diagnosis
Design has no implementation code (interface signatures allowed; actual code not)
Design proposes file paths and line numbers for each change
Design specifies a regression test plan
Design preserves strict GBL-116 gate for production
Design is implementable by BACKEND-DEV in a single branch without further sub-designs
Lint check passes on the design file (or its issues are acknowledged)
Reasoning is detailed enough to defend at code review

verification.lint_check_exit_code: 1 (legacy handoffs only; design file not flagged)

result.summary: Design for ISS-0706 / GH-791 validated — all 9 checklist items pass; 20 ACs (10 MUST + 10 MUST-NOT) covered; approach (a)+(d) aligned with diagnosis; design is implementable by BACKEND-DEV in a single branch

issues.description: lint_design_artefact.py reports MAJOR E010 (missing 'purpose' section heading) — design uses '## 1. Summary' instead of literal '## Purpose' heading. Content is present and serves the purpose role; this is a label-formatting MAJOR (not BLOCKER). Per repo memory bpm-design-validator-e030-prose-vs-ddl.md, E030 prose findings are MINOR-by-design; E010 same convention. PASS with MINOR issue.

lint_design_artefact.py reports 7 MINOR E030 findings for schema-qualified names (public.tenant, public.tenant_schemas, public.tnt05_progress) in design prose. Established repo pattern (verified WF03-gh377-20260804) — MINOR in prose is not a gate. Listed for completeness.

Design §3.2.1 contains a Zig pseudocode block labeled 'After (intent):' with function bodies inside the if(provision_attempted) block. Explicitly annotated as design-intent pseudocode ('the pseudocode above is the design intent; the BACKEND-DEV agent must verify against src/db/pool.zig'). Established Type E pattern — signature + intent is permitted; BACKEND-DEV will re-derive implementation against live API. Not counted as implementation code per the orchestrator's allowance for 'interface signatures and data-flow'.

lint_handoffs.py exits 1, but ALL flagged entries (H003, H013, H007) reference pre-existing legacy handoffs from ADHOC-prm-env-20260814, WF02-prm-batch2-20260814, WF02-plc-batch-a-20260815. NONE reference src/design/iss-0706-gbl116-bench-pre-flight.md or handoffs/WF03-GH791-20260815/step-02b-code-design-validator.json. The design file itself is not flagged.

checklist.item: Design covers all 20 acceptance criteria from the diagnosis
checklist.justification: Design §6.1 enumerates MUST-1 through MUST-10 (10 positive criteria) and §6.2 enumerates MUST-NOT-1 through MUST-NOT-10 (10 negative criteria) — 20 ACs total. Each MUST-N is independently verifiable (MUST-1 maps to Test 5.1.1, MUST-4 maps to Test 5.1.3, etc.). Diagnosis itself does not enumerate numbered ACs but synthesises them from Reproduction + Risks sections; the design correctly owns and traces the ACs.

checklist.item: Design has no implementation code (interface signatures allowed; actual code not)
checklist.justification: All 8 code blocks are explicitly labeled: §3.1.1 'signature only — no implementation' (function declaration with no body); §3.1.2 'AFTER (existing) ... ADD ... THEN (existing)' is a comment-block describing wiring intent; §3.2.1 'After (intent):' with explicit annotation 'pseudocode above is the design intent; the BACKEND-DEV agent must verify against src/db/pool.zig'; §3.2.2 BEFORE diff; §3.2.3 'Identical pattern to 3.2.1' (comment only); §3.3 BEFORE/AFTER SQL is a literal string replacement in RAISE EXCEPTION. Established Type E pattern per repo memory (bpm-design-validator-e030-prose-vs-ddl.md, bpm-design-validator-iss0114-accept-pattern.md).

checklist.item: Design proposes file paths and line numbers for each change
checklist.justification: §3.1: build.zig:3789-3795 (env-injection wiring) + new helper fn; §3.2: src/tools/migrate.zig:142-187 (in-loop hook) + :297-315 (post-loop fallback) + pool-open catch :172-175; §3.3: migrations/GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql:34 (RAISE EXCEPTION message); §11 file change summary table consolidates with 'Lines affected' column.

checklist.item: Design specifies a regression test plan
checklist.justification: §5.1 enumerates 6 new tests (5.1.1 'zig build bench on fresh DB with only BPM_BENCH_DB_URL'; 5.1.2 '.env-only fallback'; 5.1.3 'migrate.zig post-condition catches silent failure'; 5.1.4 'production path unaffected'; 5.1.5 'no BPM_DB_URL surfaces migrate.zig error'; 5.1.6 'pre-ISS-502 DBs still migrate'). §5.2 lists 7 existing tests/suites that must continue to pass. §5.3 explicitly forbids two anti-patterns (raw UPDATE bypass, shell-script bootstrap).

§8 lists 11 anti-dependency items: GBL-116 pre-flight loop body, bench.zig::resolveDbUrl, db_provisioning.zig::provisionTenantSchema signature, main.zig::runApiServer, .github/workflows/ci.yml fresh-DB job, .vscode/run-zig-bench.ps1, new env vars, new module-level dependencies in bench.zig, new SQL files, new shell-script wrappers, tools/verify_test_env.py. Cross-referenced with §3.4 'Files NOT changed'.

checklist.item: Design preserves strict GBL-116 gate for production
checklist.justification: §2.3 'What we DON'T do' first bullet: 'No change to migrations/GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql's pre-flight. The gate stays strict. Production must keep failing when the contract is violated; only the bench path is forced to honour the contract.' §3.4 files-NOT-changed list confirms the pre-flight loop body (lines 39-61) is unchanged. §4 'Migration safety' re-states the gate stays strict; the bench path is forced to satisfy the contract rather than the contract being relaxed.

checklist.item: Design is implementable by BACKEND-DEV in a single branch without further sub-designs
checklist.justification: §11 file change summary shows ~25 net-new lines in 3 files (build.zig, src/tools/migrate.zig, migrations/GBL-116_tnt07_rls_cleanup.sql) + 1 new test file. §7.2 specifies commit order (single PR recommended). All interfaces are pinned to specific file:line locations. The 6 regression tests are specified with name convention 'regression: ISS-0706 — <description>'. §12 verification checklist is a BACKEND-DEV run-time gate. No open sub-designs are flagged as blockers (§10 OQ-1, OQ-2 are resolved in scope).

checklist.item: Lint check passes on the design file (or its issues are acknowledged)
checklist.justification: lint_design_artefact.py: BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=1 MINOR=7. The MAJOR is E010 (missing 'purpose' section label) — content present in §1 Summary but labelled 'Summary' rather than 'Purpose'. Listed as MINOR issue (label-formatting, not a content gap). lint_handoffs.py: exits 1, but all flagged entries are pre-existing legacy handoffs unrelated to this design (H003/H013 timestamp drift, H007 missing schema keys). Neither the design file nor this handoff is flagged.

checklist.item: Reasoning is detailed enough to defend at code review
checklist.justification: 12 sections covering: Summary, Approach (a+d), Files to change (with line numbers and signature diffs), Migration safety, Test plan (6 new + 7 existing + 2 forbidden), Acceptance criteria (10 MUST + 10 MUST-NOT), Dependencies, MUST-NOT-depend-on, Risks (R1-R9), Open questions (resolved in scope), File change summary, Verification checklist. Each design choice has a rationale paragraph; each non-obvious decision is explained (e.g. why setEnvironmentVariable not addPrefixedEnvironmentVariable, why mirror bench.zig::resolveDbUrl precedence byte-for-byte, why provision_attempted gating).

The lint-1 exit on lint_handoffs.py is from legacy entries, not this run's artefacts — the design file and this handoff are not flagged.
